newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH KOKOOMUS PICKS AURA FOR TRANSPORT PORTFOLIO.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH KOKOOMUS PICKS AURA FOR TRANSPORT PORTFOLIO.

text.p: The parliamentary group of Finland's Conservative Party (Kokoomus) on Friday decided to propose MP Matti Aura, who is also managing director of the Central Chamber of Commerce, as new transport minister, the party said in a statement.
Aura would succeed conservative MP Tuula Linnainmaa in the five-party left-right-green cabinet. Linnainmaa has been appointed governor of the Southern Finland province.
The Finnish transport minister's responsibilities include road, rail, sea and air traffic, and telecommunications. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
